name: Wood Methanol Recovery
mechanism: Capture wood-carbonization vapors and separate a methanol-bearing fraction from watery condensate and tar; further refining distinguishes usable methanol from crude mixed solvent.
operating_requirement: Pay suitable Timber, retort and condenser capacity, heat, water, separation work and feed-quality trials; account for low variable methanol recovery and rejected watery or tarry fractions.
consequence: Supply qualified methanol to a known formaldehyde process; charcoal making alone neither supplies pure methanol nor permits counting the same timber twice.
branching_note: These are selected game production pathways, not claims that other historical implementations are impossible. All listed foundations apply; knowledge never supplies equipment or materials.
recovery: Acquire attributable wood methanol recovery instruction or working samples, then pay for local setup and acceptance trials.

route_terms.scholar_envoy: Pay a reachable specialist, travel, consumable practice stock and supervised local wood methanol recovery trials.
route_terms.partnership: Share actual samples and operator time for wood methanol recovery; independently inspect the partner output.
route_terms.purchased_research: Fund a bounded wood methanol recovery process trial with recorded materials, failures and output checks.
route_terms.licensed_or_imported_service: Pay for finite external wood methanol recovery processing; delivered material does not grant local manufacture.
route_terms.reverse_engineering: Inspect an attributable wood methanol recovery machine or processed sample and pay to reproduce its result; hidden settings may prevent success.

name: Silver Cupellation
mechanism: Oxidize the lead and base-metal carrier of a qualified silver-bearing metal charge, retaining a noble-metal-rich residue and separating oxidized material in a consumable hearth lining.
operating_requirement: Pay assayed silver-bearing feed, any required lead collector, fuel, furnace work and lining replacement; retain slag/litharge and metal losses, and verify the recovered silver grade.
consequence: Provide recovered silver for separately qualified catalyst fabrication; ordinary Lead Ore has no implied silver content and recovered noble metal is not automatically catalyst-ready or separated from gold.
branching_note: These are selected game production pathways, not claims that other historical implementations are impossible. All listed foundations apply; knowledge never supplies equipment or materials.
recovery: Acquire attributable silver cupellation instruction or working samples, then pay for local setup and acceptance trials.

name: Formaldehyde Synthesis
mechanism: Convert qualified methanol through a selected catalytic oxidation/dehydrogenation route and absorb the resulting formaldehyde into a defined solution.
operating_requirement: Pay named methanol feed, maintained qualified catalyst, controlled air handling, reaction and cooling capacity, water, separation work and output checks; retain catalyst wear and rejected fractions.
consequence: Supply a specified formaldehyde solution to paid condensation-resin production; solution is not anhydrous monomer, finished resin or permission to substitute every catalyst.
branching_note: These are selected game production pathways, not claims that other historical implementations are impossible. All listed foundations apply; knowledge never supplies equipment or materials.

name: Urea Synthesis
mechanism: React defined ammonia and carbon-dioxide feeds through the carbamate-to-urea pathway, separating product from unconverted material.
operating_requirement: Pay named Ammonia and Carbon Dioxide, maintained pressure plant, heat, cooling and separation work; bounded recycle retains makeup requirements and losses, and product qualification consumes samples.
consequence: Supply qualified urea to a known urea-formaldehyde resin process; generic nitrogen stock or atmospheric carbon cannot bypass captured feeds and conversion equipment.
